promotionalText: One beautiful quote every morning, on a full-screen photo and in your language. Add the widget to your Home or Lock Screen. Free, no account, no ads.
whatsNew:
BeWise 3.0 is a complete rebuild:
• Ready for iPhone Duo, folded and open
• Now in your language: BeWise follows your phone and translates every quote
• Quote of the day widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• A fresh quote every morning, on a beautiful photo
• New design with a native tab bar and smooth transitions
• Share quotes as image cards and get a daily reminder
description:
BeWise gives you one beautiful quote every morning, set on a full-screen photograph and written in your language. Ten seconds to read. A whole day to carry.

Start your day with motivation, not with a feed. No scrolling, no streaks, no noise: just the quote of the day, chosen for the theme you need right now.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE BEWISE
• A new inspirational quote every morning, from more than 1,100 hand-picked quotes by writers, leaders, athletes and thinkers
• 9 themes: Inspiration, Leadership, Life, Love, Humour, Art, Sports, Students and Programming
• Your language, automatically: BeWise follows your phone and translates every quote and screen
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with today's quote and its photo
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you choose
• The full archive: scroll back through every past quote
• Love the quotes that speak to you and share any quote as a ready-to-post image
• Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo

CALM BY DESIGN
• Free, with no account, no ads and no tracking

Make it a ritual: open BeWise with your morning coffee, add the widget to your Lock Screen, and let one good thought set the tone for your day.
